sprintName: Global Lesson Directory, Production Hardening & System Telemetry
goals: Deliver public global topic & lesson catalog visible to all (Requirement 9)
Implement real-time audit logging and MongoDB Atlas telemetry synchronization

issues.title: [Curriculum] Global Topic & Lesson Repository with Full-Text Search, Category Filters, and Syllabus Overview
issues.description: Provide a centralized, public directory of all faculty-authored lessons and topics (visible to all students and guests). Include full-text keyword search, year level and term filters, and syllabus overviews.
issues.implementationDetails:
### Implementation Architecture & Details

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Centralized global repository of all faculty-authored topics and lessons, accessible and visible to all (Requirement 9).

#### 2. Capabilities
- Global keyword search across all subject topics, lesson summaries, and lecture notes.
- Filtering by semester, academic year level, and faculty instructor.
- Syllabus overview cards allowing prospective students to explore curriculum outlines.

#### Verified implementation
- Paginated public metadata directory with title/summary/lecture-text/course/instructor keyword matching, year/term/instructor/format filters, syllabus overviews and prerequisite-aware learning-path links. Full notes/files/keys remain protected.

issues.title: [System] Audit Logging, Telemetry Health Dashboard & MongoDB Atlas Live Synchronization Engine
issues.description: Implement persistent audit logging for assessment attempts, credential events, and curriculum publication. Provide administrative connection health monitoring and MongoDB Atlas database synchronization checks.
issues.implementationDetails:
### Implementation Architecture & Details

#### 1. Scope & Objective
Comprehensive audit logging, telemetry health monitor, and MongoDB Atlas database connection synchronization engine.

#### 2. Monitoring Metrics
- Assessment submission latency and transaction logs.
- MongoDB Atlas cluster connection pool health and failover metrics.
- Security event logging for authentication attempts and honor code compliance.

#### Verified implementation
- Persistent privacy-filtered credential/publication/assessment/integrity/export audit events, idempotent result records, latency statistics, faculty operations dashboard, trusted operator account-ID allowlist, real MongoDB ping/write/read/delete checks, pool/topology event monitoring, and 15-second dashboard refresh. Configured connection failures never silently switch to temporary storage; production requires persistent storage and disables default demo seeding.
